queries.compiledQueryString: select distinct year from f1.drivers order by year desc
queries.inputQueryString: select distinct year from f1.drivers order by year desc

queries.compiledQueryString:
select
    championship_position,
    headshot_url,
    driver_name,
    team_name,
    championship_points,
    wins,
    podiums,
    poles,
    starts,
    avg_qualifying,
    avg_finish,
    avg_positions_gained,
    dnfs,
    driver_link
from f1.drivers
where year = ${inputs.season.value}
order by championship_position nulls last, championship_points desc
